name: Static Palm
description: Rub the palms together with slow circulating qi until static gathers and the hands of the user tingle.

name: Spark Cup
description: Cup the palm and snap a single dry spark at a target within arm's reach.

name: Ozone Draw
description: Breathe in through the nose and read the sharp scent of charge gathering in the nearby air.

name: Bright Snap
description: Flick two fingers against a target so a bead of stored charge snaps into the skin.

name: Skin Hum
description: Hold charge in a thin hum over the forearm so a glancing blow slides off the tingling skin.

name: Heel Skip
description: Push off with a pulse of charge in the heel to hop one pace aside.

name: Spark Flick
description: Flick a stored spark off the thumbnail across a short gap at a target's face.

name: Palm Jolt
description: Press the open palm to a target's chest and let a charge jump the gap into the body.

name: Palm Hum
description: Raise a thin shell of static before the palm to blunt a thrown stone or a weak blow.

name: Bolt Duet
description: Snap a spark from each hand in turn, the second following the first by one breath.

name: Pale Glint
description: Snap a pale flash at eye level so the target blinks and loses half a beat.

name: Tingle Read
description: Hold a hand toward a body and feel its small natural charge, finding living things near the user.

name: Fist Charge
description: Close a spark inside the fist and release it into the next punch, adding a bite of shock.

name: Slow Gather
description: Draw static from the air into both palms over several slow breaths, filling the user with charge.

name: Sudden Release
description: Dump all gathered charge through one hand into a target in a single hard snap.

name: Breath Shell
description: Hold the breath and keep charge under the skin of the torso so the body shrugs off a light hit.

name: Flat Discharge
description: Release charge from both palms in a flat short fan that stings everyone close in front of the user.

name: Heel Bleed
description: Bleed surplus charge down through the heel into the earth so a backlash cannot burn the hands.

name: Quick Arc
description: Throw a short bright arc from the hand to a target a few paces off.

name: Arc Hop
description: Jump a short arc between the hands and the feet to lurch one long step forward.

name: Short Arc
description: Close to arm's length and let the arc jump straight from the knuckles into the target.

name: Arc Catch
description: Catch the tip of a weapon on a crackling arc and turn it wide of the body.

name: Wrist Flare
description: Flare charge off the wrist at a target's eyes so the next move is made half blind.

name: Dry Crackle
description: Run a crackle along a held weapon to jar the wielder's grip and spoil the swing.

name: Arc Trace
description: Send a thin trace of charge ahead and feel where it grounds to find a hidden body or metal.

name: Prong Arc
description: Split the arc into two fine prongs that drive through cloth and thin padding to the skin.

name: Ozone Breath
description: Breathe the metallic tang of charge in through the nose and spread it to the limbs of the user.

name: Charged Air
description: Taste the air for rising charge and read where a stronger source of lightning stands.

name: Breath Jab
description: Exhale sharply as a straight punch lands so the stored charge leaps with the breath.

name: Lung Ward
description: Pack charge around the ribs with each in-breath to blunt blows aimed at the chest.

name: Exhale Spark
description: Blow a thin spark off the lips at a target's hand or face.

name: Still Pulse
description: Press a calm pulse onto a target's own small charge so its nerves slow for a moment.

name: Grounded Stance
description: Plant both feet wide and sink charge into the ground to stand firm against a shove.

name: Leg Lead
description: Lead the force of a blow down along the leg into the earth instead of the spine.

name: Heel Anchor
description: Pin one heel with charge so a pull or a sweep finds the user planted fast.

name: Low Arc
description: Sweep a low arc along the ground to shock a target's ankles and lower legs.

name: Earth Tap
description: Tap the heel and read the currents that return through the ground to find nearby movement.

name: Settle Charge
description: Let scattered charge settle low in the legs, steadying the body for the next exchange.

name: Stamp Crack
description: Stamp a foot so a crackle runs along the ground in a short line and stings feet in its path.

name: Crackle Step
description: Pop a pulse of charge in the heel to cover a single pace in a flicker.

name: Snap Turn
description: Spin on the ball of the foot with a spark in the ankle to face a new line in one beat.

name: Skip Pivot
description: Skip to the side and pivot on the same pulse, ending beside the line of attack.

name: Double Hop
description: Chain two short hops on two pulses, closing or opening distance with a spark each time.

name: Step Strike
description: Hop in on a pulse and land a charged punch before the target can set.

name: Sparking Heel
description: Snap the heel down on a target's foot so the leg twitches and the stance breaks.

name: Clap Burst
description: Clap the hands sharply to send a crack of pressure and sparks over everyone close.

name: Hand Crack
description: Slap a charged open hand across a target's guard with a sound like a snapped branch.

name: Clap Ward
description: Clap against an incoming arrow or thrown object so the shock turns it away.

name: Dull Thud
description: Send a low thump through the air that rings in a target's ears and spoils their balance.

name: Echo Clap
description: Follow a first clap with a second close behind so the pressure lands twice on the same ground.

name: Bright Fork
description: Throw a forked arc whose two prongs both bite into a single target.

name: Fork Point
description: Point two fingers and loose a narrow forked spark at a target out of arm's reach.

name: Fork Catch
description: Catch a blade between the two prongs of a small fork and twist it off line.

name: Split Spark
description: Divide one spark into two so that it touches two separate targets standing close together.

name: Fork Read
description: Let a fork of charge feel a room's edges and the bodies in it by where each prong grounds.

name: Fork Grip
description: Pin a limb between two fine arcs so the muscle locks and the arm cannot be raised.

name: Needle Glint
description: Fire a thin glint straight into a target's eyes to dazzle them for a breath.

name: Fork Jab
description: Jab two stiff fingers into a target's ribs with a forked charge running behind them.

name: Conducting Touch
description: Touch the blade or armour a target holds and send the charge through it into their hands and body.

name: Wire Run
description: Send a spark racing along a held cord or chain to a target at the far end.

name: Rod Charge
description: Fill a held metal rod with charge until it hums, so each touch of it bites harder.

name: Metal Feel
description: Run charge over the hands and feel what metal lies near by how the charge is drawn toward it.

name: Lead Away
description: Draw a hostile spark away from the body into a held bit of metal and throw it down.

name: Plate Snap
description: Snap charge into a target's armour so the plates clamp and seize the limbs inside them.

name: Cord Whip
description: Crack a charged cord across a target's arm so the cord bites and the charge follows.
